decision: Does the mocked delivery work end to end, and does the launch show real buy intent?
hypothesis: Delivery passes every end-to-end test, and at least 3% of at least 500 eligible store visitors request access within 14 days.

criteria.label: End-to-end delivery tests passing
criteria.help: Share of delivery tests that pass (FIXTURE data)

criteria.label: Failure cases tested
criteria.help: Duplicate order, failed email, invalid product, ...

criteria.label: Eligible store visitors
criteria.help: Unique non-internal visitor IDs with a store page view in the window

criteria.label: Mock buy-intent rate
criteria.help: Unique buy intents (CTA clicks / no-charge requests) / eligible store visitors

notes: Technical and demand criteria are separate: test fixtures never count as visitors or intents. Exclusions: internal/test traffic, fixture and bot-flagged events, duplicates (visitor ID / email hash), events outside the window. Too few visitors routes to 2.1 (channels); visitors without buy intent routes to 4.1 (price), or 2.2 (positioning) by founder choice.
